integrity: Detailed combinatorial proof, finite independent transition enumeration and exact integer convolution are supplied; no independent external validation or historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The recurrence trichotomy and exact count require loopless complete graphs and incumbent-retaining ties. Critical asymptotics hold with fixed integer k>=2 and q/n^(k/(k-1)) tending to a positive constant; no claim for k growing or arbitrary sparse graphs. Standard occupancy factorial moments are used without a claim to novelty as an independent probabilistic theorem.
title: An infinite hierarchy of Poisson oscillation windows for deterministic plurality on cliques
